newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa aims to publish Nov trade data on Friday.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa aims to publish Nov trade data on Friday.

text.p: The South African Revenue Services (SARS) said on Thursday it aimed to release November trade figures on Friday morning.
"It looks almost certain that the figures will be released at 0800 GMT on Friday," an official said.
South Africa's trade surplus rocketed to 3.9 billion rand in October from 666.7 million rand in September - far exceeding economists' most optimistic forecasts.
Hefty South African gold and Botswana diamond exports were the main reasons for the sharp rise in the trade surplus, which includes data for other countries in the Southern Africa Customs Union.
South Africa has now recorded a trade surplus every month since July 1996.
